### You

clicking one of the slot config buttons with an item in cursor double plays the button sound, do you have enough information to dig this behavior? i believe it has to do with an override that is duping

### Gemini

Yes, there is enough information to diagnose this exact behavior. What you are experiencing is a classic GUI event overlap that causes both a **double sound** and an **item duplication (dupe) bug**.

### Why This Happens

1. **The Duplication Vector**: When you click the center config/ghost slot while holding an item in your cursor, your code reads `menu.getCarried()` and creates a `ghostCopy` for the module's NBT data:
  ```java
  ItemStack carried = this.menu.getCarried();
  ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);
  procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, ...);
  ```
  Because this is a ghost/config slot, **it copies the item without consuming it from your cursor**. You still keep your full stack in hand.
2. **The Double Sound & Event Overlap**: When you click on that slot (or near the overlay buttons) while holding an item, `MachineInfoScreen#mouseClicked` fires your custom overlay logic. However, because an item is in your cursor and the click coordinates overlap with the underlying container slot, **vanilla container handling (`slotClicked`) also fires** immediately after or alongside it.
  This causes two things to happen on a single click:
  This dual execution causes the sound to play twice and creates a desync where the item in your cursor interacts with the inventory slot while simultaneously being cloned into the config NBT.
  - Your custom logic runs (setting the filter/target and playing or triggering state changes).
  - Vanilla container logic also runs, attempting to place, swap, or deposit the item from your cursor into the underlying machine slot.

### The Fix

To resolve both the double sound and the duplication glitch, you need to ensure that **any click caught by the active configuration overlay strictly consumes the event** (`return true;`) and prevents fall-through to vanilla slot clicks.

In **`MachineInfoScreen.java`**, check your `mouseClicked` method. When clicking valid overlay buttons or the config slot, make sure it returns `true` immediately so `super.mouseClicked` (and subsequent slot click dispatches) never run:

```java
@Override
public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
    if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
        Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
        MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

        if (blockEntity != null) {
            ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
            int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
            int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

            // 1. Processing Module Center Config Ghost Slot
            if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule) {
                if (procModule.hasConfigSlot() && mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                    ItemStack carried = this.menu.getCarried();
                    ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                    assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                    procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    
                    // CRITICAL: Return true immediately to consume the event 
                    // and prevent vanilla slotClicked from firing!
                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            // Same goes for your directional buttons and close buttons:
            // Ensure every matched button branch returns true!
        }
    }

    return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
}
```

Additionally, double-check your `slotClicked` override in `MachineInfoScreen` to ensure it doesn't process container interactions when an overlay is actively open on that slot.

### Gemini

The double sound and item placement bug occurs because clicking the center button triggers both `mouseClicked` (which handles the button action) and `slotClicked` (which fires container slot logic and plays an extra sound). Because the center button occupies the exact same slot coordinates as the inventory slot, container logic intercepts the click when holding an item, causing the item in your cursor to place or swap into the slot.

You can fix this by guarding `slotClicked` so that clicking an already configured slot does not re-trigger sound or execute inventory actions while the overlay is open.

### Updated `slotClicked` in `MachineInfoScreen.java`

Update your `slotClicked` method in **`MachineInfoScreen.java`** with the following implementation:

```java
    @Override
    protected void slotClicked(@Nullable Slot slot, int slotId, int mouseButton, @NotNull ClickType type) {
        if (type == ClickType.QUICK_CRAFT) {
            assert slot != null;
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Allow player inventory interactions while the module config overlay is open
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index >= 27) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction and duplicate sounds when clicking buttons on the active config slot
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index == configuringSlotIndex) {
            return;
        }

        if (slot != null && slot.index < 27) {
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);

                if (moduleStack.is(ModItems.IO_MODULE.get()) || moduleStack.getItem() instanceof ProcessingModuleItem) {
                    if (configuringSlotIndex != slot.index) {
                        if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                            this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                    SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                    0.5F,
                                    1.0F
                            );
                        }
                        configuringSlotIndex = slot.index;
                    }
                    return;
                }

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.api.module.IConfigurableModule) {
                    if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                        this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                0.5F,
                                1.0F
                        );
                    }
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundOpenModuleConfigPacket(slot.index, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        configuringSlotIndex = -1;

        if (slot != null) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
        }
    }
```

### Verification

- **Verification:** Launch your test client, open an IO or processing module configuration overlay while holding items in your cursor, and click the center button. The mode cycles cleanly with a single click sound, and items remain securely in your cursor without placing into the slot.

Yes, IntelliJ IDEA includes a built-in inspection tool that automatically scans your project to find unused methods, fields, and classes.

Here are the steps to run this inspection:

3. Select **Inspect Code...** from the dropdown list.

You can also rely on real-time code highlighting while you write. IntelliJ dims the names of private or package-private methods that lack references inside the current scope, and hovering over them displays a warning message.                         Map<Direction, IoModuleItem.FaceMode> modes = IoModuleItem.getFaceModes(moduleStack);
```java
                        IoModuleItem.FaceMode nextMode = modes.get(clickedDir).next();
                        IoModuleItem.setFaceMode(moduleStack, clickedDir, nextMode);

                        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(slot.index, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                        return true; // CONSUME EVENT: Prevents item placement or slot interaction
                    }

                    // Close Overlay Button (X)
                    if (mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16) {
                        if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                            this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                    SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                    0.5F,
                                    1.0F
                            );
                        }
                        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                        return true; // CONSUME EVENT
                    }
                }

                // --- 2. PROCESSING MODULE OVERLAY CLICKS ---
                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule) {
                    // Center config ghost slot click
                    if (procModule.hasConfigSlot() && mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                        ItemStack carried = this.menu.getCarried();
                        ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                        assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                        procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                        return true; // CONSUME EVENT
                    }

                    // Directional Cross Buttons
                    Direction clickedDir = getProcessingClickedDirection(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
                    if (clickedDir != null) {
                        if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                            this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                    SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                    0.5F,
                                    1.0F
                            );
                        }
                        ProcessingModuleItem.SlotMode nextMode = procModule.getNextMode(moduleStack, clickedDir);
                        ProcessingModuleItem.setSlotMode(moduleStack, clickedDir, nextMode, procModule.getModuleConfigKey());

                        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleModuleDirectionPacket(slot.index, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                        return true; // CONSUME EVENT
                    }

                    // Close Overlay Button (X)
                    if (mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2) {
                        if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                            this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                    SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                    0.5F,
                                    1.0F
                            );
                        }
                        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                        return true; // CONSUME EVENT
                    }
                }

                // If an overlay is open, clicking anywhere else on the grid slot bounds 
                // while holding an item should be blocked so it doesn't accidentally swap items.
                if (mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                    return true; 
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }
```

### Why this works:

- Returning `true` from `mouseClicked` tells Minecraft's input system: *"This click was completely handled by the GUI overlay, stop processing it further."*
- Because the event is consumed right there, **vanilla slot interaction and item swapping never get triggered**, meaning items stay safely in your cursor, buttons cycle modes smoothly with a single click sound, and the menu closes exclusively via the `X` button or by clicking outside the active overlay layout.

```java
@Override
public boolean handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
    // 1. Check face buttons
    Direction clickedDir = getIoClickedDirection(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
    if (clickedDir != null) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        Map<Direction, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
        FaceMode nextMode = modes.get(clickedDir).next();
        setFaceMode(stack, clickedDir, nextMode);

        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(slotIndex, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        return true; // Consumed
    }

    // 2. Close Button (X)
    if (mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        return true; // Signals screen to close overlay
    }

    // 3. Block any other clicks inside the active slot bounds while overlay is open
    return mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16;
}

private Direction getIoClickedDirection(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY)) return Direction.NORTH;
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY - 18)) return Direction.UP;
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY + 18)) return Direction.DOWN;
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX - 18, slotY)) return Direction.WEST;
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 18, slotY)) return Direction.EAST;
    if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 36, slotY)) return Direction.SOUTH;
    return null;
}

private boolean isInside(double mx, double my, int x, int y) {
    return mx >= x && mx < x + 16 && my >= y && my < y + 16;
}
```

```java
@Override
public boolean handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
    // 1. Center config ghost slot click
    if (hasConfigSlot() && mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
        // Handled via screen carried item, but consumed here
        return false; // Let screen handle carried item swap/ghost setting
    }

    // 2. Directional Cross Buttons
    Direction clickedDir = getProcessingClickedDirection(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
    if (clickedDir != null) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        SlotMode nextMode = getNextMode(stack, clickedDir);
        setSlotMode(stack, clickedDir, nextMode, getModuleConfigKey());

        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleModuleDirectionPacket(slotIndex, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        return true; // Consumed
    }

    // 3. Close Button (X)
    if (mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        return true; // Signals screen to close
    }

    return mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16;
}

private Direction getProcessingClickedDirection(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
    int centerX = slotX + 8;
    int centerY = slotY + 8;
    int offset = 18;

    if (isInsideButton(mx, my, centerX, slotY - (offset - 8))) return Direction.UP;
    if (isInsideButton(mx, my, slotX - (offset - 8), centerY)) return Direction.WEST;
    if (isInsideButton(mx, my, slotX + 16 + (offset - 8), centerY)) return Direction.EAST;
    if (isInsideButton(mx, my, centerX, slotY + 16 + (offset - 8))) return Direction.DOWN;
    return null;
}

private boolean isInsideButton(double mx, double my, int x, int y) {
    return mx >= x - 8 && mx < x + 8 && my >= y - 8 && my < y + 8;
}
```

### Step 3: Clean up `MachineInfoScreen.java`

Now, **`MachineInfoScreen` becomes completely decoupled from specific module types**. It simply asks the module item to handle the click:

Replace your `mouseClicked` method in `MachineInfoScreen.java` with this clean, polymorphic version:

```java
@Override
public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
    if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
        Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
        MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

        if (blockEntity != null) {
            ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
            int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
            int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

            if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                // Special check for processing module center config slot (requires carried item context)
                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule && procModule.hasConfigSlot() && 
                    mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                    ItemStack carried = this.menu.getCarried();
                    ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                    assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                    procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    return true;
                }

                // Delegate general click handling to the module itself
                boolean handled = baseModule.handleCustomClick(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY, moduleStack, blockEntity, slot.index, this.minecraft);
                if (baseModule instanceof IoModuleItem && mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16) {
                    configuringSlotIndex = -1; // Close IO overlay
                    return true;
                }
                if (baseModule instanceof ProcessingModuleItem && mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2) {
                    configuringSlotIndex = -1; // Close Processing overlay
                    return true;
                }
                if (handled) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
}
```

### Why this solves it permanently:

1. **True Polymorphism:** Third-party developers can now add completely custom modules with their own overlay layouts and click rules simply by overriding `handleCustomClick` in their custom item class—**zero modifications required in `MachineInfoScreen`**.
2. **Strict Event Interception:** Because the module returns `true` on button clicks, the screen intercepts the event instantly, preventing items in your cursor from interacting with the slot underneath.

To finally solve both issues, the two main classes you need to check and update are **`MachineInfoScreen.java`** alongside your module item classes (**`BaseModuleItem.java`**, **`IoModuleItem.java`**, and **`ProcessingModuleItem.java`**).

### Root Causes of the Behavior

1. **Why the X button stopped working**: During the refactoring to make the code fully modular, the screen-level check that closed the overlay upon clicking the X button was removed. The module items returned `true` for handling the click, but they had no way to tell the screen to set `configuringSlotIndex = -1`, leaving the menu stuck open or unresponsive to close requests.
2. **Why items on the cursor still place or swap**: When you click the X button or a configuration button, setting `configuringSlotIndex = -1` instantly removes the overlay protection. Minecraft immediately evaluates the click on the newly exposed inventory slot underneath, causing any item held on your cursor to drop into that slot.

### How to Fix It Cleanly

To preserve your clean modular architecture while fixing both bugs permanently, you can update your classes using a structured approach:

#### 1. Define a Click Result in `BaseModuleItem`

Instead of returning a simple boolean from `handleCustomClick`, have it return an enum result so the module can explicitly tell the screen whether to **consume the click**, **close the overlay**, or **pass**:

```java
public enum ClickResult {
    PASS,
    CONSUME,
    CLOSE
}
```

#### 2. Update `IoModuleItem` and `ProcessingModuleItem`

When the player clicks the `X` button, have the module return `ClickResult.CLOSE`. When they click a mode toggle button, have it return `ClickResult.CONSUME`.

#### 3. Handle the Close State Safely in `MachineInfoScreen`

In `MachineInfoScreen.java`, when a module returns `ClickResult.CLOSE`, set `configuringSlotIndex = -1` **and** consume the event so that container slot interactions do not fire on that same click. Additionally, add a short input guard in `slotClicked` to ensure that closing the overlay ignores slot actions for that tick.

### Gemini

Defining an explicit **`ClickResult` enum** in `BaseModuleItem` is the cleanest, most robust way to handle this. It gives modules fine-grained control over what the screen should do (`PASS`, `CONSUME`, or `CLOSE`), ensuring that clicking the `X` button closes the menu and **strictly consumes the click event** so your held item never accidentally drops or swaps into the slot underneath.

Here is how to implement and organize this across your classes to keep everything fully modular and future-proof for third-party addons.

### Step 1: Add `ClickResult` to `BaseModuleItem.java`

Open **`BaseModuleItem.java`** and define the enum along with the updated `handleCustomClick` signature:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

public class BaseModuleItem extends Item {
    public BaseModuleItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    public enum ClickResult {
        PASS,       // Not handled by the overlay, let screen fall through
        CONSUME,    // Click handled (e.g., toggled a button), keep overlay open
        CLOSE       // Click handled and requests closing the overlay (e.g., clicked X)
    }

    public ClickResult handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, Minecraft minecraft) {
        return ClickResult.PASS;
    }

    public void renderModuleOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, Slot slot, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity) {}

    public boolean shouldHideSlot(int configuringSlotIndex, int targetSlotIndex) {
        int row = configuringSlotIndex / 9;
        int col = configuringSlotIndex % 9;

        if (targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex) return true;
        if (row > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 9) return true;
        if (row < 2 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 9) return true;
        if (col > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 1) return true;
        if (col < 8 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 1) return true;
        return row > 0 && col > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 10;
    }

    public void renderCustomOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font) {}

    public void tickModule(Level level, BlockPos pos, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, ItemStack stack) {}

    public void openConfiguration(ServerPlayer player, ItemStack moduleStack, int slotIndex, BlockPos blockPos) {}
}
```

```java
public ClickResult handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
    Direction clickedDir = getIoClickedDirection(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
    if (clickedDir != null) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        Map<Direction, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
        FaceMode nextMode = modes.get(clickedDir).next();
        setFaceMode(stack, clickedDir, nextMode);

        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(slotIndex, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        return ClickResult.CONSUME;
    }

    // Close Button (X)
    if (mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        return ClickResult.CLOSE;
    }

    if (mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
        return ClickResult.CONSUME;
    }

    return ClickResult.PASS;
}
```

By delegating `isInsideOverlay` down to the module items, `MachineInfoScreen` remains 100% generic. Any future or third-party module can define its own button positions and its clicks will automatically be caught and protected without needing changes to the screen class.

```java
@Override
public ClickResult handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
    // 1. Center config ghost slot click (Polymorphically handled here instead of the screen)
    if (hasConfigSlot() && mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
        if (minecraft.player != null && minecraft.player.containerMenu != null) {
            ItemStack carried = minecraft.player.containerMenu.getCarried();
            ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

            assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
            setConfigSlotItem(stack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
            PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slotIndex, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        }
        return ClickResult.CONSUME;
    }

    Direction clickedDir = getProcessingClickedDirection(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
    if (clickedDir != null) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        SlotMode nextMode = getNextMode(stack, clickedDir);
        setSlotMode(stack, clickedDir, nextMode, getModuleConfigKey());

        PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleModuleDirectionPacket(slotIndex, clickedDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        return ClickResult.CONSUME;
    }

    // Close Button (X)
    if (mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2) {
        if (minecraft.player != null) {
            minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
        }
        return ClickResult.CLOSE;
    }

    if (mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
        return ClickResult.CONSUME;
    }

    return ClickResult.PASS;
}

@Override
public boolean opensInlineOverlay() {
```

```java
import com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;

import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class MachineInfoScreen extends AbstractContainerScreen<MachineInfoMenu> {
    private static final ResourceLocation TEXTURE =
            ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace("textures/gui/container/shulker_box.png");

    private int configuringSlotIndex = -1;

    public MachineInfoScreen(MachineInfoMenu menu, Inventory playerInventory, Component title) {
        super(menu, playerInventory, title);
        this.imageWidth = 176;
        this.imageHeight = 166;
        this.inventoryLabelY = this.imageHeight - 94;
    }

    @Override
    protected void renderBg(GuiGraphics guiGraphics, float partialTick, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionTexShader);
        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1.0F, 1.0F, 1.0F, 1.0F);

        int x = (this.width - this.imageWidth) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - this.imageHeight) / 2;

        guiGraphics.blit(TEXTURE, x, y, 0, 0, this.imageWidth, this.imageHeight);
    }

    private boolean isSlotInActiveOverlay(int slotIndex) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex < 0 || configuringSlotIndex >= 27) return false;
        Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
        MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();
        if (blockEntity == null) return false;

        ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
        if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
            return baseModule.shouldHideSlot(configuringSlotIndex, slotIndex);
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected void renderSlot(@NotNull GuiGraphics graphics, @NotNull Slot slot) {
        if (isSlotInActiveOverlay(slot.index)) {
            return;
        }

        super.renderSlot(graphics, slot);

        if (slot.index < 27) {
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.client.ModuleScreenRenderer.renderModuleOverlay(graphics, slot, moduleStack, blockEntity, this.font);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void render(@NotNull GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        this.renderBackground(guiGraphics, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
        super.render(guiGraphics, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
        this.renderTooltip(guiGraphics, mouseX, mouseY);

        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int renderX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int renderY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    baseModule.renderCustomOverlay(guiGraphics, renderX, renderY, moduleStack, blockEntity, this.font);
                } else {
                    configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    // Delegate click handling entirely to the module item
                    BaseModuleItem.ClickResult result = baseModule.handleCustomClick(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY, moduleStack, blockEntity, slot.index, this.minecraft);

                    if (result == BaseModuleItem.ClickResult.CLOSE) {
                        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                        return true;
                    } else if (result == BaseModuleItem.ClickResult.CONSUME) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    // Fallback protection: consume any click landing inside the module overlay bounds
                    if (baseModule.isInsideOverlay(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    protected void slotClicked(@Nullable Slot slot, int slotId, int mouseButton, @NotNull ClickType type) {
        if (type == ClickType.QUICK_CRAFT) {
            assert slot != null;
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Allow player inventory interactions while the module config overlay is open
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index >= 27) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction if the slot is hidden under the active config overlay
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && isSlotInActiveOverlay(slot.index)) {
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction and duplicate sounds when clicking buttons on the active config slot
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index == configuringSlotIndex) {
            return;
        }

        if (slot != null && slot.index < 27) {
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.opensInlineOverlay()) {
                        if (configuringSlotIndex != slot.index) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            configuringSlotIndex = slot.index;
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof IConfigurableModule) {
                    if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                        this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                0.5F,
                                1.0F
                        );
                    }
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundOpenModuleConfigPacket(slot.index, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        configuringSlotIndex = -1;

        if (slot != null) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
        }
    }
}
```

When you click the `X` button, your code sets `configuringSlotIndex = -1` **immediately mid-click**. To fix this permanently and make the architecture fully modular for any future custom module, two things must happen:

```java
    // and vertical bounds from Up to Down.
    return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX < slotX + 52 &&
           mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY < slotY + 34;
```

```java
                        // Special check for processing module center config slot

                                mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
```

```java
private boolean pendingClose = false;

@Override
public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
    if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
        Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
        MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

            int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
            int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                    // Special check for processing module center config slot
                    if (baseModule instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule && procModule.hasConfigSlot() &&

                            PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                        }
                        return true;
                    }

                    // Flag close action for mouse release so the slot stays hidden during the press
                    if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        pendingClose = true;
                        if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {

                    if (result == BaseModuleItem.ClickResult.CONSUME) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
}

@Override
public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
    if (pendingClose) {
        pendingClose = false;
        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
        return true;
    }
```

```java
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int renderX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int renderY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.isInsideOverlay(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        // Special check for processing module center config slot
                        if (baseModule instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule && procModule.hasConfigSlot() &&
                                mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                ItemStack carried = this.minecraft.player.containerMenu.getCarried();
                                ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                                assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                                procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                                PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                            }
                            return true;

                        // Flag close action for mouse release so the slot stays hidden during the press
                        if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                            pendingClose = true;
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            return true;
                        }

                        // Delegate other clicks (like face/cross buttons)
                        BaseModuleItem.ClickResult result = baseModule.handleCustomClick(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY, moduleStack, blockEntity, slot.index, this.minecraft);
                        if (result == BaseModuleItem.ClickResult.CONSUME) {
                            return true;
                        }

                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (pendingClose) {
            pendingClose = false;
            configuringSlotIndex = -1;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    protected void slotClicked(@Nullable Slot slot, int slotId, int mouseButton, @NotNull ClickType type) {
        if (type == ClickType.QUICK_CRAFT) {
            assert slot != null;
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Allow player inventory interactions while the module config overlay is open
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index >= 27) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction if the slot is hidden under the active config overlay
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && isSlotInActiveOverlay(slot.index)) {
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction and duplicate sounds when clicking buttons on the active config slot
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index == configuringSlotIndex) {
            return;
        }

        if (slot != null && slot.index < 27) {
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.opensInlineOverlay()) {
                        if (configuringSlotIndex != slot.index) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            configuringSlotIndex = slot.index;
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof IConfigurableModule) {
                    if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                        this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                0.5F,
                                1.0F
                        );
                    }
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundOpenModuleConfigPacket(slot.index, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        configuringSlotIndex = -1;

        if (slot != null) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
        }
    }
}
```

### Gemini

That explains the mystery completely. When the `X` button is positioned in the leftmost column (`slotX - 36`), it renders **outside the standard container screen rectangle (`imageWidth`/`imageHeight`)** into the dark background area (`image_919ac2.png`).

In vanilla Minecraft, clicking outside the container boundary rectangle while holding an item on your cursor triggers `hasClickedOutside`, which treats the click as an outside drop/close action and causes the item on your cursor to drop into the world or trigger unintended closure.

### The Permanent Fix

To solve this for any current or future module (whether IO, Processing, or third-party addons), you can override **`hasClickedOutside`** in **`MachineInfoScreen`**. If a click lands within an active module's defined overlay bounds (`isInsideOverlay`), we tell Minecraft: *"No, this click is not outside the valid UI interface; it is inside our active module overlay."*

This completely prevents vanilla from treating off-grid buttons as outside clicks, keeping your item safe on your cursor.

```java
                        // 1. Special check for processing module center config slot
                        if (baseModule instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule && procModule.hasConfigSlot() &&
                                mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                ItemStack carried = this.minecraft.player.containerMenu.getCarried();
                                ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                                assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                                procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                                PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                            }
                            return true;
                        }

                        // 2. Flag close action for mouse release (X button)
                        if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                            pendingClose = true;
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            return true;
                        }

                        // 3. Delegate configuration face/output buttons (e.g. U, D, W, E, S, N)
                        BaseModuleItem.ClickResult result = baseModule.handleCustomClick(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY, moduleStack, blockEntity, slot.index, this.minecraft);
                        
                        // Always consume the event so vanilla never treats off-grid clicks as outside drops/closes
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }
```

### Why this fixes the face/output buttons:

- **Immediate Interception:** By checking `isInsideOverlay` at the absolute top of `mouseClicked` and returning `true`, Minecraft's screen code short-circuits. It never reaches vanilla's background outside-click logic.
- **Cursor and UI Protection:** Your item stays secured on your cursor, the face/output buttons cycle their configurations properly, and the config UI stays open exactly as intended.

### Gemini

The debug logs and screenshots (`image_31b860.png`, `image_31b845.png`) expose the exact cause of the input lock.

`isInsideOverlay` was returning `true` for a **giant solid rectangle** that covered the entire area containing all the buttons and the empty space between them. When you clicked into the empty space or adjacent slots inside that large red box, the screen intercepted and swallowed the click, preventing you from placing items into the inventory slots underneath.

To fix this permanently, `isInsideOverlay` must be refactored from a single giant bounding box into **precise individual component checks** so that empty margin space is ignored and clicks pass straight through to the inventory slots.

### Step 1: Update `IoModuleItem.java`

Update `isInsideOverlay` in **`IoModuleItem.java`** to return `true` **only** when the mouse is over one of the actual buttons, the center slot, or the `X` close button:

```java
@Override
public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
    // Center slot / North
    boolean north = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // Up button
    boolean up = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2;
    // Down button
    boolean down = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY + 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 34;
    // West button
    boolean west = mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // East button
    boolean east = mouseX >= slotX + 18 && mouseX <= slotX + 34 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // South button
    boolean south = mouseX >= slotX + 36 && mouseX <= slotX + 52 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // X Close button
    boolean close = mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;

    return north || up || down || west || east || south || close;
}
```

### Step 2: Update `ProcessingModuleItem.java`

Update `isInsideOverlay` in **`ProcessingModuleItem.java`** similarly so it only covers the active processing buttons, config slot, and close button:

```java
@Override
public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
    // Center slot
    boolean center = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // Up button
    boolean up = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2;
    // Down button
    boolean down = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY + 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 34;
    // West / Left button
    boolean west = mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // East / Right button
    boolean east = mouseX >= slotX + 18 && mouseX <= slotX + 34 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    // X Close button
    boolean close = mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2;

    return center || up || down || west || east || close;
}
```

### Step 3: Clean up `MachineInfoScreen.java`

You can now remove the temporary red debug rectangle code from your `render` method in **`MachineInfoScreen.java`** since the exact button boundaries are now cleanly mapped.

### Why This Solves It

- **Precise Hitboxes:** Clicks register strictly on the buttons and the central slot.
- **Seamless Inventory Interaction:** Clicking on empty margin space or adjacent inventory slots bypasses the overlay entirely, allowing items on your cursor to be placed instantly without delay or input locks.

### Gemini

The debug logs reveal the exact smoking gun. Look at this sequence from your console:

```plaintext
[DEBUG SLOT CLICK] slotId=-999 | slotIndex=null | type=QUICK_CRAFT | configuringIdx=-1
```

### The Root Cause

The culprit is the guard inside the `QUICK_CRAFT` block (`if (slot != null)`).

When you click and hold an item to drag or paint it across multiple inventory slots, Minecraft uses `ClickType.QUICK_CRAFT`. Throughout this drag-painting lifecycle, Minecraft frequently passes a null slot (`slotId = -999`) to manage the drag state.

Because the old code had `if (slot != null)` wrapping `super.slotClicked`, it swallowed those null quick-craft packets completely and did nothing. That broke Minecraft's native item distribution system, locking up your ability to place or distribute items until you happened to land on a valid slot with a standard `PICKUP` click.

### The Fix

Allow `QUICK_CRAFT` events to pass through to `super.slotClicked` regardless of whether the slot is null, letting vanilla handle the drag state machine properly.

Update your `slotClicked` method in **`MachineInfoScreen.java`**:

```java
    @Override
    protected void slotClicked(@Nullable Slot slot, int slotId, int mouseButton, @NotNull ClickType type) {
        System.out.println(
                "[DEBUG SLOT CLICK] slotId=" + slotId +
                " | slotIndex=" + (slot != null ? slot.index : "null") +
                " | type=" + type +
                " | configuringIdx=" + configuringSlotIndex
        );

        if (type == ClickType.QUICK_CRAFT) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Allow player inventory interactions while the module config overlay is open
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index >= 27) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction if the slot is hidden under the active config overlay
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && isSlotInActiveOverlay(slot.index)) {
            return;
        }

        // Prevent container interaction and duplicate sounds when clicking buttons on the active config slot
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && slot != null && slot.index == configuringSlotIndex) {
            return;
        }

        if (slot != null && slot.index < 27) {
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.opensInlineOverlay()) {
                        if (configuringSlotIndex != slot.index) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            configuringSlotIndex = slot.index;
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof IConfigurableModule) {
                    if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                        this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                0.5F,
                                1.0F
                        );
                    }
                    PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundOpenModuleConfigPacket(slot.index, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0) {
            return;
        }

        configuringSlotIndex = -1;

        if (slot != null) {
            super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
        }
    }
```

That minor quirk happens because the bottom edge of the Down (`D:D`) button on modules placed in the bottom row extends slightly into the area of the inventory slot directly underneath it. When you click that overlapping segment, the click coordinates fall just outside the current overlay bounding box, causing the screen to treat it as a click on the inventory slot and drop your item.

Expanding the hit-detection and overlay bounds for the Down button downwards by a few pixels ensures clicks on that intersection are fully intercepted and consumed by the overlay.

### Step 1: Update `ProcessingModuleItem.java`

Update `isInsideOverlay` and `getProcessingClickedDirection` in **`ProcessingModuleItem.java`** to extend the Down button hitbox downwards:

```java
    @Override
    public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        boolean center = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
        boolean up = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2;
        // Extended downward to cover the inventory overlap segment
        boolean down = mouseX >= slotX && mouseX <= slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY + 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 38;
        boolean west = mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
        boolean east = mouseX >= slotX + 18 && mouseX <= slotX + 34 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
        boolean close = mouseX >= slotX - 18 && mouseX <= slotX - 2 && mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY - 2;

        return center || up || down || west || east || close;
    }

    private Direction getProcessingClickedDirection(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
        int centerX = slotX + 8;
        int centerY = slotY + 8;
        int offset = 18;

        if (isInsideButton(mx, my, centerX, slotY - (offset - 8))) return Direction.UP;
        if (isInsideButton(mx, my, slotX - (offset - 8), centerY)) return Direction.WEST;
        if (isInsideButton(mx, my, slotX + 16 + (offset - 8), centerY)) return Direction.EAST;
        // Extended Down click detection range
        if (mx >= centerX - 8 && mx <= centerX + 8 && my >= slotY + 18 && my <= slotY + 38) return Direction.DOWN;
        return null;
    }
```

### Step 2: Update `IoModuleItem.java`

Update `isInsideOverlay` and `getIoClickedDirection` in **`IoModuleItem.java`** as well:

```java
    @Override
    public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        // Extended bottom bound to cover the inventory overlap segment
        return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX + 52 &&
                mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 38;
    }

    private Direction getIoClickedDirection(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY)) return Direction.NORTH;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY - 18)) return Direction.UP;
        // Extended Down click detection range
        if (mx >= slotX && mx <= slotX + 16 && my >= slotY + 18 && my <= slotY + 38) return Direction.DOWN;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX - 18, slotY)) return Direction.WEST;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 18, slotY)) return Direction.EAST;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 36, slotY)) return Direction.SOUTH;
        return null;
    }
```

### Why This Fixes It

Clicks landing on that overlapping bottom segment are now successfully claimed by the active module overlay, cycling the Down face mode correctly without dropping items into the underlying inventory slot.

It happens because of **`hasClickedOutside`**. When you click outside the GUI rectangle (where the red `X` button lives), `AbstractContainerScreen` checks if you clicked outside. Even if `mouseClicked` returns `true`, vanilla's underlying mouse event handling or container state might still evaluate outside coordinates if `hasClickedOutside` permits it.

Let's override `hasClickedOutside` to return `false` whenever a config overlay is open, ensuring clicks on buttons outside the main box are entirely owned by our screen logic.

### The Fix

Make sure your `hasClickedOutside` method in **`MachineInfoScreen.java`** looks like this:

```java
    @Override
    protected boolean hasClickedOutside(double mouseX, double mouseY, int left, int top, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        return super.hasClickedOutside(mouseX, mouseY, left, top, button);
    }
```

### Why This Fixes It

When `configuringSlotIndex >= 0`, `hasClickedOutside` returns `false`. This tells vanilla's screen framework: *"Do not treat clicks outside the main GUI background as outside container clicks."* Because of this, clicking the off-grid close button while holding an item will close the overlay cleanly without triggering vanilla's item-drop behavior.

### Gemini

The item drops because when you click the off-grid `X` button, `configuringSlotIndex` was being set to `-1` immediately inside `mouseClicked`. As soon as it became `-1`, Minecraft's `hasClickedOutside` check evaluated the click coordinates (which lie outside the standard 176x166 GUI box) and treated it as a genuine "click outside the GUI while holding an item," triggering vanilla's item-drop logic.

To fix this, we can keep the config overlay active during the mouse press (preventing vanilla from dropping the item) and handle closing the overlay cleanly on **mouse release** (`mouseReleased`), while also making `hasClickedOutside` strictly return `false` whenever an overlay click is in progress.

### The Fix

Update **`MachineInfoScreen.java`** with these updated methods:

```java
    @Override
    protected boolean hasClickedOutside(double mouseX, double mouseY, int left, int top, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 || lastClickWasOverlay) {
            return false;
        }
        return super.hasClickedOutside(mouseX, mouseY, left, top, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex < 0 && this.isDragging()) {
            this.setDragging(false);
        }

        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();

            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.isInsideOverlay(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        lastClickWasOverlay = true;
                        this.setDragging(false);

                        if (baseModule instanceof ProcessingModuleItem procModule && procModule.hasConfigSlot() &&
                                mouseX >= slotX && mouseX < slotX + 16 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY < slotY + 16) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                ItemStack carried = this.minecraft.player.containerMenu.getCarried();
                                ItemStack ghostCopy = carried.isEmpty() ? ItemStack.EMPTY : carried.copyWithCount(1);

                                assert blockEntity.getLevel() != null;
                                procModule.setConfigSlotItem(moduleStack, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getLevel().registryAccess());
                                PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundSetModuleConfigItemPacket(slot.index, ghostCopy, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
                            }
                            return true;
                        }

                        // Consume the click on the close button and play sound, deferring close to mouseReleased
                        if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.player != null) {
                                this.minecraft.player.playNotifySound(
                                        SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(),
                                        net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                                        0.5F,
                                        1.0F
                                );
                            }
                            return true;
                        }

                        baseModule.handleCustomClick(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY, moduleStack, blockEntity, slot.index, this.minecraft);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        lastClickWasOverlay = false;
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27 && lastClickWasOverlay) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                        lastClickWasOverlay = false;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        lastClickWasOverlay = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }
```

### Why This Works

- **Outside-Click Protection:** `hasClickedOutside` returns `false` while `lastClickWasOverlay` is true, ensuring vanilla never mistakes your off-grid button click for an outside-GUI item drop.
- **Deferred Closure:** By closing the overlay in `mouseReleased` rather than `mouseClicked`, the menu stays fully active during the click press, keeping your held cursor items 100% safe.

Not a catch-22 at all, just one final piece of the event lifecycle puzzle!

Here is why it happened: while `mouseClicked` and `slotClicked` were successfully ignoring the click, **`mouseReleased`** was still falling through to `super.mouseReleased`. When you released the mouse over that overlapping inventory slot, vanilla's container screen caught the mouse-up event and said, *"Ah, the user finished clicking this inventory slot, let's process the slot action / drop the item!"*

To solve both the off-grid `X` buttons and the overlapping `D` buttons once and for all, we just need `mouseReleased` to also consume the event whenever `lastClickWasOverlay` is active.

### The Fix

Update your `mouseReleased` method in **`MachineInfoScreen.java`**:

```java
    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (configuringSlotIndex >= 0 && configuringSlotIndex < 27 && lastClickWasOverlay) {
            Slot slot = this.menu.slots.get(configuringSlotIndex);
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity = this.menu.getBlockEntity();
            if (blockEntity != null) {
                ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(slot.index);
                int slotX = slot.x + this.leftPos;
                int slotY = slot.y + this.topPos;

                if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                    if (baseModule.isCloseButton(mouseX, mouseY, slotX, slotY)) {
                        configuringSlotIndex = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
            lastClickWasOverlay = false;
            return true; // Consumes the mouse release so vanilla never processes a slot click or drop!
        }

        lastClickWasOverlay = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }
```

### Why This Works

- **Complete Event Ownership:** By returning `true` in `mouseReleased` when `lastClickWasOverlay` is true, vanilla's underlying inventory handler is completely cut out of the loop on mouse-up.
- **Universal Harmony:** Both off-grid buttons (like the `X` button) and overlapping on-grid buttons (like the bottom row `D` button) now cleanly cycle their states or close the overlay without ever touching your held cursor items or the inventory slots underneath.

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.api.module.IModuleMenuProvider;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;
```
