```java
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandler;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.items.ItemStackHandler;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class MachineFrameworkBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements MenuProvider {

    // 27 slots x 4 generic status channels per slot.
    // Safe future-proofing hook: these channels store custom states, progress values,
    // or fluid levels for current and upcoming processing modules.
    // Channel 0: Progress / Burn Time
    // Channel 1: Max Progress / Burn Time Total / Wear
    // Channel 2: Secondary Progress / Fluid / Energy Level
    // Channel 3: Secondary Max / Capacity / Extra State
    private final int[][] moduleData = new int[27][4];

    /**
     * Retrieves the numerical value stored in a specific status channel for a given module slot.
     */
    public int getModuleData(int slot, int channel) {
        if (slot < 0 || slot >= 27 || channel < 0 || channel >= 4) return 0;
        return moduleData[slot][channel];
    }

    /**
     * Updates a specific status channel for a given module slot and triggers a block state sync to the client.
     */
    public void setModuleData(int slot, int channel, int value) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < 27 && channel >= 0 && channel < 4) {
            if (moduleData[slot][channel] != value) {
                moduleData[slot][channel] = value;
                setChanged();
                if (level != null && !level.isClientSide()) {
                    level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), 3);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Handler managing the 27 module slots within the machine framework.
    private final ItemStackHandler moduleHandler = new ItemStackHandler(27) {
        @Override
        public boolean isItemValid(int slot, @NotNull ItemStack stack) {
            return stack.is(ModTags.Items.MACHINE_MODULES);
        }

        @Override
        public int getSlotLimit(int slot) {
            return 1;
        }

        @Override
        public @NotNull ItemStack insertItem(int slot, @NotNull ItemStack stack, boolean simulate) {
            if (!isItemValid(slot, stack)) return stack;

            // Automatically initializes IO module default face states to DISABLED across all relative sides upon insertion.
            if (stack.is(ModItems.IO_MODULE.get()) && !stack.has(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA)) {
                ItemStack singleModule = stack.copyWithCount(1);
                for (RelativeSide side : RelativeSide.values()) {
                    IoModuleItem.setFaceMode(singleModule, side, IoModuleItem.FaceMode.DISABLED);
                }
                return super.insertItem(slot, singleModule, simulate);
            }

            if (stack.is(ModItems.FILTER_MODULE.get()) && !stack.has(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA)) {
                ItemStack singleModule = stack.copyWithCount(1);
                singleModule.set(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData.EMPTY);
                singleModule.set(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.MAX_STACK_SIZE, 1);
                return super.insertItem(slot, singleModule, simulate);
            }

            return super.insertItem(slot, stack, simulate);
        }

        @Override
        public @NotNull ItemStack extractItem(int slot, int amount, boolean simulate) {
            ItemStack extracted = super.extractItem(slot, amount, simulate);

            if (!simulate && !extracted.isEmpty()) {
                if (extracted.is(ModTags.Items.PROCESSING_MODULES)) {
                    com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom.ProcessingModuleItem.saveProgressData(MachineFrameworkBlockEntity.this, slot, extracted);
                }

                for (int ch = 0; ch < 4; ch++) {
                    setModuleData(slot, ch, 0);
                }
            }

            return extracted;
        }
    };

    // Handler managing the internal item inventory slots corresponding to each grid position.
    private final ItemStackHandler inventoryHandler = new ItemStackHandler(27) {
        @Override
        protected void onContentsChanged(int slot) {
            setChanged();
        }
    };

    public MachineFrameworkBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlockEntities.MACHINE_FRAMEWORK_BE.get(), pos, state);
    }

    public ItemStackHandler getModuleHandler() {
        return moduleHandler;
    }

    public ItemStackHandler getInventoryHandler() {
        return inventoryHandler;
    }

    public boolean hasInventoryModule(int slotIndex) {
        ItemStack stack = moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(slotIndex);
        return stack.getItem() instanceof com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom.InventoryModuleItem;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket getUpdatePacket() {
        return net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public @NotNull CompoundTag getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.@NotNull Provider registries) {
        CompoundTag tag = super.getUpdateTag(registries);
        saveAdditional(tag, registries);
        return tag;
    }

    @Override
    public @NotNull Component getDisplayName() {
        return Component.translatable("block.praeteritum_futurum.machine_framework");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public AbstractContainerMenu createMenu(int containerId, @NotNull Inventory playerInventory, @NotNull Player player) {
        return new MachineConfigMenu(containerId, playerInventory, this);
    }

    public AbstractContainerMenu createInfoMenu(int containerId, Inventory playerInventory, Player player) {
        return new MachineInfoMenu(containerId, playerInventory, this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(@NotNull CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.@NotNull Provider registries) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag, registries);
        tag.put("Modules", moduleHandler.serializeNBT(registries));
        tag.put("Inventory", inventoryHandler.serializeNBT(registries));

        int[] flatData = new int[27 * 4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 27; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(moduleData[i], 0, flatData, i * 4, 4);
        }
        tag.putIntArray("ModuleData", flatData);
    }

    @Override
    public void loadAdditional(@NotNull CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.@NotNull Provider registries) {
        super.loadAdditional(tag, registries);
        if (tag.contains("Modules")) {
            moduleHandler.deserializeNBT(registries, tag.getCompound("Modules"));
        }
        if (tag.contains("Inventory")) {
            inventoryHandler.deserializeNBT(registries, tag.getCompound("Inventory"));
        }
        if (tag.contains("ModuleData")) {
            int[] flatData = tag.getIntArray("ModuleData");
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(flatData.length, 27 * 4); i++) {
                moduleData[i / 4][i % 4] = flatData[i];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the adjacent grid slot indices (up, down, left, right) for a given slot index.
     */
    public int[] getAdjacentSlots(int slotIndex) {
        int row = slotIndex / 9;
        int col = slotIndex % 9;

        List<Integer> neighbors = new ArrayList<>();

        if (row > 0) {
            neighbors.add(slotIndex - 9);
        }
        if (row < 2) {
            neighbors.add(slotIndex + 9);
        }
        if (col > 0) {
            neighbors.add(slotIndex - 1);
        }
        if (col < 8) {
            neighbors.add(slotIndex + 1);
        }

        return neighbors.stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray();
    }

    /**
     * Server-side tick logic running every tick to process modules and handle item push/pull automation based on relative IO configurations.
     */
    public static void serverTick(
            net.minecraft.world.level.Level level,
            BlockPos blockPos,
            BlockState state,
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity
    ) {
        if (level.isClientSide()) return;

        for (int i = 0; i < blockEntity.moduleHandler.getSlots(); i++) {
            ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(i);
            if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                baseModule.tickModule(level, blockEntity.getBlockPos(), blockEntity, i, moduleStack);
            }
        }

        if (level.getGameTime() % 10 != 0) return;

        Direction machineFacing = state.hasProperty(com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.custom.MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING)
                ? state.getValue(com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.custom.MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING)
                : Direction.NORTH;

        for (int i = 0; i < blockEntity.moduleHandler.getSlots(); i++) {
            ItemStack moduleStack = blockEntity.moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(i);

            if (moduleStack.is(ModItems.IO_MODULE.get())) {
                Map<RelativeSide, IoModuleItem.FaceMode> modes = IoModuleItem.getFaceModes(moduleStack);

                for (Map.Entry<RelativeSide, IoModuleItem.FaceMode> entry : modes.entrySet()) {
                    Direction worldDir = entry.getKey().toWorldDirection(machineFacing);
                    if (entry.getValue() == IoModuleItem.FaceMode.OUTPUT) {
                        blockEntity.pushItemsToSide(i, worldDir);
                    } else if (entry.getValue() == IoModuleItem.FaceMode.INPUT) {
                        blockEntity.pullItemsFromSide(i, worldDir);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pulls items from an external inventory into adjacent inventory modules.
     */
    private void pullItemsFromSide(int moduleSlot, Direction side) {
        if (level == null) return;

        int[] adjacentIndices = getAdjacentSlots(moduleSlot);
        for (int adj : adjacentIndices) {
            ItemStack adjModule = moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(adj);

            if (adjModule.is(ModItems.INVENTORY_MODULE.get())) {
                BlockPos sourcePos = worldPosition.relative(side);
                IItemHandler sourceHandler = level.getCapability(
                        net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK,
                        sourcePos,
                        side.getOpposite()
                );

                if (sourceHandler != null) {
                    IItemHandler targetHandler = new SingleSlotItemHandler(inventoryHandler, adj);
                    transferItems(sourceHandler, targetHandler, moduleSlot, adj);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pushes items from internal inventory modules out to an external inventory.
     */
    private void pushItemsToSide(int moduleSlot, Direction side) {
        if (level == null) return;

        int[] adjacentIndices = getAdjacentSlots(moduleSlot);
        for (int adj : adjacentIndices) {
            ItemStack adjModule = moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(adj);

            if (adjModule.is(ModItems.INVENTORY_MODULE.get())) {
                IItemHandler sourceHandler = new SingleSlotItemHandler(inventoryHandler, adj);
                BlockPos targetPos = worldPosition.relative(side);

                IItemHandler targetHandler = level.getCapability(
                        net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK,
                        targetPos,
                        side.getOpposite()
                );

                if (targetHandler != null) {
                    transferItems(sourceHandler, targetHandler, moduleSlot, adj);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Exposes item handlers for external automation and pipe connections on specific world directions.
     */
    public IItemHandler getItemHandlerForSide(Direction side) {
        if (side == null || level == null) return null;

        List<IItemHandlerModifiable> targetHandlers = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < moduleHandler.getSlots(); i++) {
            ItemStack moduleStack = moduleHandler.getStackInSlot(i);
            if (moduleStack.getItem() instanceof BaseModuleItem baseModule) {
                IItemHandlerModifiable handler = baseModule.getItemHandlerForSide(level, worldPosition, this, i, moduleStack, side);
                if (handler != null) {
                    targetHandlers.add(handler);
                }
            }
        }

        if (targetHandlers.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return new CombinedInvWrapper(targetHandlers.toArray(new IItemHandlerModifiable[0]));
    }

    /**
     * Helper method to transfer items between handlers while respecting filter restrictions.
     */
    private void transferItems(IItemHandler source, IItemHandler target, int ioModuleSlot, int targetSlotIndex) {
        for (int i = 0; i < source.getSlots(); i++) {
            ItemStack extracted = source.extractItem(i, 1, true);

            if (!extracted.isEmpty()) {
                if (FilterModuleItem.isItemBlockedByFilters(this, ioModuleSlot, targetSlotIndex, extracted)) {
                    continue;
                }

                ItemStack remainder = extracted.copy();

                for (int j = 0; j < target.getSlots(); j++) {
                    remainder = target.insertItem(j, remainder, false);
                    if (remainder.isEmpty()) break;
                }

                int moved = extracted.getCount() - remainder.getCount();
                if (moved > 0) {
                    source.extractItem(i, moved, false);
                    setChanged();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.RelativeSide;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.custom.MachineFrameworkBlock;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.network.ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.TooltipFlag;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import java.util.*;

public class IoModuleItem extends LogisticsModuleItem {
    public IoModuleItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    /**
     * Renders the background overlay texture on top of the module slot in the GUI.
     */
    @Override
    public void renderModuleOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, Slot slot, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity) {
        graphics.blit(
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "textures/gui/container/io_module_overlay.png"),
                slot.x, slot.y,
                0.0f, 0.0f,
                16, 16,
                16, 16
        );
    }

    /**
     * Defines the bounding box area that triggers the inline configuration overlay when interacting with the slot.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        // Extended bottom bound to cover the inventory overlap segment
        return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX + 52 &&
                mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 38;
    }

    /**
     * Determines which relative side button (Front, Back, Left, Right, Up, Down) the player clicked in the overlay UI.
     */
    private RelativeSide getIoClickedRelativeSide(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY)) return RelativeSide.FRONT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY - 18)) return RelativeSide.UP;
        if (mx >= slotX && mx <= slotX + 16 && my >= slotY + 18 && my <= slotY + 38) return RelativeSide.DOWN;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX - 18, slotY)) return RelativeSide.LEFT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 18, slotY)) return RelativeSide.RIGHT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 36, slotY)) return RelativeSide.BACK;
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Specifies that IO modules use an inline UI overlay rather than opening a separate menu screen.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean opensInlineOverlay() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Hides underlying container slots when the configuration overlay is open to prevent accidental item clicks.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean shouldHideSlot(int configuringSlotIndex, int targetSlotIndex) {
        int row = configuringSlotIndex / 9;
        int col = configuringSlotIndex % 9;

        if (targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex) return true;
        if (row > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 9) return true;
        if (row < 2 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 9) return true;
        if (col > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 1) return true;
        if (col < 8 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 1) return true;
        if (col < 7 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 2) return true;
        return col > 1 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 2;
    }

    /**
     * Renders the interactive configuration overlay buttons (F, B, L, R, U, D) around the module slot.
     */
    @Override
    public void renderCustomOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font) {
        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);

        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY, "F", modes.get(RelativeSide.FRONT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY - 18, "U", modes.get(RelativeSide.UP));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY + 18, "D", modes.get(RelativeSide.DOWN));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX - 18, slotY, "L", modes.get(RelativeSide.LEFT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX + 18, slotY, "R", modes.get(RelativeSide.RIGHT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX + 36, slotY, "B", modes.get(RelativeSide.BACK));

        // Close button
        graphics.fill(slotX - 36, slotY, slotX - 20, slotY + 16, 0xFF8B0000);
        graphics.drawCenteredString(font, "X", slotX - 28, slotY + 4, 0xFFFFFF);
    }

    /**
     * Helper method to draw an individual relative face configuration button with its color and state label.
     */
    private void drawConfigButton(GuiGraphics graphics, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, int x, int y, String faceLabel, FaceMode mode) {
        graphics.fill(x, y, x + 16, y + 16, 0xFF888888);
        graphics.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + 15, y + 15, mode != null ? mode.getColor() : FaceMode.DISABLED.getColor());

        String charLabel = mode != null ? mode.getLabelChar() : "D";
        graphics.drawCenteredString(font, faceLabel + ":" + charLabel, x + 8, y + 4, 0xFFFFFF);
    }

    @Override
    public void openConfiguration(ServerPlayer player, ItemStack moduleStack, int slotIndex, BlockPos blockPos) {
        // Client-side overlay handled via screen state
    }

    /**
     * Handles mouse clicks on the configuration overlay, cycles the face mode, updates NBT, and syncs to the server.
     */
    @Override
    public void handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
        RelativeSide clickedSide = getIoClickedRelativeSide(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
        if (clickedSide != null) {
            if (minecraft.player != null) {
                minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
            }
            Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
            FaceMode nextMode = modes.get(clickedSide).next();
            setFaceMode(stack, clickedSide, nextMode);

            Direction facing = Direction.NORTH;
            if (blockEntity.getBlockState().hasProperty(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING)) {
                facing = blockEntity.getBlockState().getValue(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING);
            }
            Direction worldDir = clickedSide.toWorldDirection(facing);
            PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(slotIndex, worldDir, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Helper check to see if mouse coordinates are inside a standard 16x16 button area.
     */
    private boolean isInside(double mx, double my, int x, int y) {
        return mx >= x && mx < x + 16 && my >= y && my < y + 16;
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the user clicked the close button on the overlay menu.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean isCloseButton(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    }

    /**
     * Provides an item handler for external pipes and automation based on the configured relative side modes.
     */
    @Override
    public @Nullable net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable getItemHandlerForSide(
            net.minecraft.world.level.Level level,
            BlockPos pos,
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity,
            int slotIndex,
            ItemStack stack,
            Direction side) {
        if (blockEntity == null) return null;

        Direction machineFacing = Direction.NORTH;
        if (blockEntity.getBlockState().hasProperty(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING)) {
            machineFacing = blockEntity.getBlockState().getValue(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING);
        }
        RelativeSide relSide = RelativeSide.fromWorldDirection(side, machineFacing);

        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
        FaceMode mode = modes.get(relSide);

        if (mode == FaceMode.DISABLED) {
            return null;
        }

        int[] adjacentIndices = blockEntity.getAdjacentSlots(slotIndex);
        List<net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable> handlers = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int adj : adjacentIndices) {
            ItemStack adjModule = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(adj);
            if (adjModule.is(com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems.INVENTORY_MODULE.get())) {
                handlers.add(new FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler(blockEntity.getInventoryHandler(), adj, blockEntity, slotIndex));
            }
        }

        if (handlers.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return new net.neoforged.neoforge.items.wrapper.CombinedInvWrapper(handlers.toArray(new net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable[0]));
    }

    /**
     * Custom item handler wrapper that checks filter rules before allowing item insertion.
     */
    public static class FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler extends com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.inventory.SingleSlotItemHandler {
        private final MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity;
        private final int ioModuleSlot;
        private final int targetSlot;

        public FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler(net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable itemHandler, int slot, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int ioModuleSlot) {
            super(itemHandler, slot);
            this.blockEntity = blockEntity;
            this.ioModuleSlot = ioModuleSlot;
            this.targetSlot = slot;
        }

        @Override
        public @NotNull ItemStack insertItem(int slot, @NotNull ItemStack stack, boolean simulate) {
            if (FilterModuleItem.isItemBlockedByFilters(blockEntity, ioModuleSlot, this.targetSlot, stack)) {
                return stack;
            }
            return super.insertItem(slot, stack, simulate);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Enum representing the operational state of an individual machine face.
     */
    public enum FaceMode {
        DISABLED(0, "D", 0xFF555555),
        INPUT(1, "I", 0xFF3366CC),
        OUTPUT(2, "O", 0xFFCC3333),
        OPEN(3, "T", 0xFF00FFCC);

        private final int id;
        private final String labelChar;
        private final int color;

        FaceMode(int id, String labelChar, int color) {
            this.id = id;
            this.labelChar = labelChar;
            this.color = color;
        }

        public String getLabelChar() {
            return labelChar;
        }

        public int getColor() {
            return color;
        }

        public static FaceMode fromId(int id) {
            for (FaceMode mode : values()) {
                if (mode.id == id) return mode;
            }
            return DISABLED;
        }

        public FaceMode next() {
            return values()[(this.ordinal() + 1) % values().length];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reads face configuration maps from the module item's NBT data.
     */
    public static Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> getFaceModes(ItemStack stack) {
        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = new EnumMap<>(RelativeSide.class);
        CompoundTag facesTag = getCustomTag(stack, "FaceModes");
        for (RelativeSide side : RelativeSide.values()) {
            if (facesTag.contains(side.name().toLowerCase())) {
                modes.put(side, FaceMode.fromId(facesTag.getInt(side.name().toLowerCase())));
            } else {
                modes.put(side, FaceMode.DISABLED);
            }
        }
        return modes;
    }

    /**
     * Writes face configuration state for a specific relative side back into the module item's NBT data.
     */
    public static void setFaceMode(ItemStack stack, RelativeSide side, FaceMode mode) {
        modifyCustomData(stack, "FaceModes", facesTag -> facesTag.putInt(side.name().toLowerCase(), mode.id));

        boolean hasConfig = getFaceModes(stack).values().stream().anyMatch(m -> m != FaceMode.DISABLED);
        updateStackSize(stack, hasConfig);
    }

    /**
     * Appends a clean, color-coded summary of face configurations to the item's tooltip.
     */
    @Override
    public void appendHoverText(@NotNull ItemStack stack, Item.@NotNull TooltipContext context, @NotNull List<Component> tooltipComponents, @NotNull TooltipFlag tooltipFlag) {
        if (stack.has(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA)) {
            Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
            tooltipComponents.add(Component.literal("§7Face Configurations:"));
            for (Map.Entry<RelativeSide, FaceMode> entry : modes.entrySet()) {
                String sideName = entry.getKey().name();
                String capitalized = sideName.charAt(0) + sideName.substring(1).toLowerCase();
                FaceMode mode = entry.getValue();

                String colorCode = switch (mode) {
                    case DISABLED -> "§8";
                    case INPUT -> "§9";
                    case OUTPUT -> "§c";
                    case OPEN -> "§a";
                };

                tooltipComponents.add(Component.literal("§8 • §f" + capitalized + ": " + colorCode + mode.name()));
            }
        }
        super.appendHoverText(stack, context, tooltipComponents, tooltipFlag);
    }
}
```

### Gemini

That error happens because Java generics for `StreamCodec` are **invariant**, meaning a codec built for a general `ByteBuf` cannot be automatically assigned where a more specific `RegistryFriendlyByteBuf` is required by the packet composite system.

To fix this cleanly and avoid the type mismatch entirely, you can construct the codec directly using **`StreamCodec.of(...)`**, explicitly typing the buffer as `RegistryFriendlyByteBuf`.

Here is the corrected `ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket.java`:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.network;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.RelativeSide;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom.IoModuleItem;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.ByteBufCodecs;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.StreamCodec;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.handling.IPayloadContext;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

public record ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(int slotIndex, RelativeSide relativeSide, BlockPos blockPos) implements CustomPacketPayload {
    public static final Type<ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket> TYPE = new Type<>(
            ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "toggle_io_face")
    );

    /**
     * StreamCodec for serializing and deserializing RelativeSide over the network using RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.
     */
    public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, RelativeSide> RELATIVE_SIDE_STREAM_CODEC = StreamCodec.of(
            (buf, side) -> buf.writeInt(side.ordinal()),
            buf -> RelativeSide.values()[buf.readInt()]
    );

    /**
     * Main StreamCodec for the packet payload.
     */
    public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket> STREAM_CODEC = StreamCodec.composite(
            ByteBufCodecs.INT,
            ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket::slotIndex,
            RELATIVE_SIDE_STREAM_CODEC,
            ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket::relativeSide,
            BlockPos.STREAM_CODEC,
            ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket::blockPos,
            ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket::new
    );

    @Override
    public @NotNull Type<ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket> type() {
        return TYPE;
    }

    /**
     * Handles the packet on the server side, updating the module face mode based on RelativeSide.
     */
    public static void handle(ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket packet, IPayloadContext context) {
        context.enqueueWork(() -> {
            ServerPlayer player = (ServerPlayer) context.player();
            if (player.level().getBlockEntity(packet.blockPos()) instanceof MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity) {
                ItemStack stack = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(packet.slotIndex());
                if (stack.is(com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems.IO_MODULE.get())) {
                    var modes = IoModuleItem.getFaceModes(stack);
                    var currentMode = modes.get(packet.relativeSide());
                    var nextMode = currentMode.next();
                    IoModuleItem.setFaceMode(stack, packet.relativeSide(), nextMode);
                    blockEntity.setChanged();
                }
            }
        });
    }
}
```

This explicitly matches the `RegistryFriendlyByteBuf` constraint and resolves the type error immediately!

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.RelativeSide;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.TooltipFlag;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import java.util.*;

public class IoModuleItem extends LogisticsModuleItem {
    public IoModuleItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    /**
     * Renders the background overlay texture on top of the module slot in the GUI.
     */
    @Override
    public void renderModuleOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, Slot slot, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity) {
        graphics.blit(
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "textures/gui/container/io_module_overlay.png"),
                slot.x, slot.y,
                0.0f, 0.0f,
                16, 16,
                16, 16
        );
    }

    /**
     * Defines the bounding box area that triggers the inline configuration overlay when interacting with the slot.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean isInsideOverlay(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        // Extended bottom bound to cover the inventory overlap segment
        return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX + 52 &&
                mouseY >= slotY - 18 && mouseY <= slotY + 38;
    }

    /**
     * Determines which relative side button (Front, Back, Left, Right, Up, Down) the player clicked in the overlay UI.
     */
    private RelativeSide getIoClickedRelativeSide(int slotX, int slotY, double mx, double my) {
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY)) return RelativeSide.FRONT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX, slotY - 18)) return RelativeSide.UP;
        if (mx >= slotX && mx <= slotX + 16 && my >= slotY + 18 && my <= slotY + 38) return RelativeSide.DOWN;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX - 18, slotY)) return RelativeSide.LEFT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 18, slotY)) return RelativeSide.RIGHT;
        if (isInside(mx, my, slotX + 36, slotY)) return RelativeSide.BACK;
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Specifies that IO modules use an inline UI overlay rather than opening a separate menu screen.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean opensInlineOverlay() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Hides underlying container slots when the configuration overlay is open to prevent accidental item clicks.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean shouldHideSlot(int configuringSlotIndex, int targetSlotIndex) {
        int row = configuringSlotIndex / 9;
        int col = configuringSlotIndex % 9;

        if (targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex) return true;
        if (row > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 9) return true;
        if (row < 2 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 9) return true;
        if (col > 0 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 1) return true;
        if (col < 8 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 1) return true;
        if (col < 7 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex + 2) return true;
        return col > 1 && targetSlotIndex == configuringSlotIndex - 2;
    }

    /**
     * Renders the interactive configuration overlay buttons (F, B, L, R, U, D) around the module slot.
     */
    @Override
    public void renderCustomOverlay(GuiGraphics graphics, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font) {
        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);

        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY, "F", modes.get(RelativeSide.FRONT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY - 18, "U", modes.get(RelativeSide.UP));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX, slotY + 18, "D", modes.get(RelativeSide.DOWN));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX - 18, slotY, "L", modes.get(RelativeSide.LEFT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX + 18, slotY, "R", modes.get(RelativeSide.RIGHT));
        drawConfigButton(graphics, font, slotX + 36, slotY, "B", modes.get(RelativeSide.BACK));

        // Close button
        graphics.fill(slotX - 36, slotY, slotX - 20, slotY + 16, 0xFF8B0000);
        graphics.drawCenteredString(font, "X", slotX - 28, slotY + 4, 0xFFFFFF);
    }

    /**
     * Helper method to draw an individual relative face configuration button with its color and state label.
     */
    private void drawConfigButton(GuiGraphics graphics, net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, int x, int y, String faceLabel, FaceMode mode) {
        graphics.fill(x, y, x + 16, y + 16, 0xFF888888);
        graphics.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + 15, y + 15, mode != null ? mode.getColor() : FaceMode.DISABLED.getColor());

        String charLabel = mode != null ? mode.getLabelChar() : "D";
        graphics.drawCenteredString(font, faceLabel + ":" + charLabel, x + 8, y + 4, 0xFFFFFF);
    }

    @Override
    public void openConfiguration(ServerPlayer player, ItemStack moduleStack, int slotIndex, BlockPos blockPos) {
        // Client-side overlay handled via screen state
    }

    /**
     * Handles mouse clicks on the configuration overlay, cycles the face mode, updates NBT, and syncs via packet.
     */
    @Override
    public void handleCustomClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY, ItemStack stack, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int slotIndex, net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft) {
        RelativeSide clickedSide = getIoClickedRelativeSide(slotX, slotY, mouseX, mouseY);
        if (clickedSide != null) {
            if (minecraft.player != null) {
                minecraft.player.playNotifySound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
            }
            Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
            FaceMode nextMode = modes.get(clickedSide).next();
            setFaceMode(stack, clickedSide, nextMode);

            // Sends the relative side directly to the server packet
            PacketDistributor.sendToServer(new ServerboundToggleIoFacePacket(slotIndex, clickedSide, blockEntity.getBlockPos()));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Helper check to see if mouse coordinates are inside a standard 16x16 button area.
     */
    private boolean isInside(double mx, double my, int x, int y) {
        return mx >= x && mx < x + 16 && my >= y && my < y + 16;
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the user clicked the close button on the overlay menu.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean isCloseButton(double mouseX, double mouseY, int slotX, int slotY) {
        return mouseX >= slotX - 36 && mouseX <= slotX - 20 && mouseY >= slotY && mouseY <= slotY + 16;
    }

    /**
     * Provides an item handler for external pipes and automation based on the configured relative side modes.
     */
    @Override
    public @Nullable net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable getItemHandlerForSide(
            net.minecraft.world.level.Level level,
            BlockPos pos,
            MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity,
            int slotIndex,
            ItemStack stack,
            Direction side) {
        if (blockEntity == null) return null;

        Direction machineFacing = Direction.NORTH;
        if (blockEntity.getBlockState().hasProperty(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING)) {
            machineFacing = blockEntity.getBlockState().getValue(MachineFrameworkBlock.FACING);
        }
        RelativeSide relSide = RelativeSide.fromWorldDirection(side, machineFacing);

        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
        FaceMode mode = modes.get(relSide);

        if (mode == FaceMode.DISABLED) {
            return null;
        }

        int[] adjacentIndices = blockEntity.getAdjacentSlots(slotIndex);
        List<net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable> handlers = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int adj : adjacentIndices) {
            ItemStack adjModule = blockEntity.getModuleHandler().getStackInSlot(adj);
            if (adjModule.is(com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems.INVENTORY_MODULE.get())) {
                handlers.add(new FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler(blockEntity.getInventoryHandler(), adj, blockEntity, slotIndex));
            }
        }

        if (handlers.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        return new net.neoforged.neoforge.items.wrapper.CombinedInvWrapper(handlers.toArray(new net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable[0]));
    }

    /**
     * Custom item handler wrapper that checks filter rules before allowing item insertion.
     */
    public static class FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler extends com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.inventory.SingleSlotItemHandler {
        private final MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity;
        private final int ioModuleSlot;
        private final int targetSlot;

        public FilteredSingleSlotItemHandler(net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable itemHandler, int slot, MachineFrameworkBlockEntity blockEntity, int ioModuleSlot) {
            super(itemHandler, slot);
            this.blockEntity = blockEntity;
            this.ioModuleSlot = ioModuleSlot;
            this.targetSlot = slot;
        }

        @Override
        public @NotNull ItemStack insertItem(int slot, @NotNull ItemStack stack, boolean simulate) {
            if (FilterModuleItem.isItemBlockedByFilters(blockEntity, ioModuleSlot, this.targetSlot, stack)) {
                return stack;
            }
            return super.insertItem(slot, stack, simulate);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Enum representing the operational state of an individual machine face.
     */
    public enum FaceMode {
        DISABLED(0, "D", 0xFF555555),
        INPUT(1, "I", 0xFF3366CC),
        OUTPUT(2, "O", 0xFFCC3333),
        OPEN(3, "T", 0xFF00FFCC);

        private final int id;
        private final String labelChar;
        private final int color;

        FaceMode(int id, String labelChar, int color) {
            this.id = id;
            this.labelChar = labelChar;
            this.color = color;
        }

        public String getLabelChar() {
            return labelChar;
        }

        public int getColor() {
            return color;
        }

        public static FaceMode fromId(int id) {
            for (FaceMode mode : values()) {
                if (mode.id == id) return mode;
            }
            return DISABLED;
        }

        public FaceMode next() {
            return values()[(this.ordinal() + 1) % values().length];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reads face configuration maps from the module item's NBT data.
     */
    public static Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> getFaceModes(ItemStack stack) {
        Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = new EnumMap<>(RelativeSide.class);
        CompoundTag facesTag = getCustomTag(stack, "FaceModes");
        for (RelativeSide side : RelativeSide.values()) {
            if (facesTag.contains(side.name().toLowerCase())) {
                modes.put(side, FaceMode.fromId(facesTag.getInt(side.name().toLowerCase())));
            } else {
                modes.put(side, FaceMode.DISABLED);
            }
        }
        return modes;
    }

    /**
     * Writes face configuration state for a specific relative side back into the module item's NBT data.
     */
    public static void setFaceMode(ItemStack stack, RelativeSide side, FaceMode mode) {
        modifyCustomData(stack, "FaceModes", facesTag -> facesTag.putInt(side.name().toLowerCase(), mode.id));

        boolean hasConfig = getFaceModes(stack).values().stream().anyMatch(m -> m != FaceMode.DISABLED);
        updateStackSize(stack, hasConfig);
    }

    /**
     * Appends a clean, color-coded summary of face configurations to the item's tooltip.
     */
    @Override
    public void appendHoverText(@NotNull ItemStack stack, Item.@NotNull TooltipContext context, @NotNull List<Component> tooltipComponents, @NotNull TooltipFlag tooltipFlag) {
        if (stack.has(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA)) {
            Map<RelativeSide, FaceMode> modes = getFaceModes(stack);
            tooltipComponents.add(Component.literal("§7Face Configurations:"));
            for (Map.Entry<RelativeSide, FaceMode> entry : modes.entrySet()) {
                String sideName = entry.getKey().name();
                String capitalized = sideName.charAt(0) + sideName.substring(1).toLowerCase();
                FaceMode mode = entry.getValue();

                String colorCode = switch (mode) {
                    case DISABLED -> "§8";
                    case INPUT -> "§9";
                    case OUTPUT -> "§c";
                    case OPEN -> "§a";
                };

                tooltipComponents.add(Component.literal("§8 • §f" + capitalized + ": " + colorCode + mode.name()));
            }
        }
        super.appendHoverText(stack, context, tooltipComponents, tooltipFlag);
    }
}
```

### You

there's directionality now but particles are pink and black

### Gemini

That classic pink-and-black checkerboard pattern on particles happens because Minecraft uses a specific texture variable called `"particle"` to determine what texture to display when blocks break, get hit, or spawn footstep particles.

When the model builder creates the cube without an explicit `particle` texture mapping, the game cannot find a valid particle sprite and falls back to the missing texture error state.

### The Fix

You can fix this instantly by chaining `.texture("particle", ...)` onto your model definition in `ModBlockStateProvider.java` to explicitly point it to your front texture (or a generic frame texture).

Here is the updated `ModBlockStateProvider.java` with the particle texture explicitly defined and comments preserved:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.datagen;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModBlocks;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import net.minecraft.data.PackOutput;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.generators.BlockStateProvider;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.generators.ModelFile;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.data.ExistingFileHelper;

public class ModBlockStateProvider extends BlockStateProvider {
    public ModBlockStateProvider(PackOutput output, ExistingFileHelper existingFileHelper) {
        super(output, PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, existingFileHelper);
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerStatesAndModels() {
        // Registers standard simple blocks with automatic item models
        simpleBlockWithItem(ModBlocks.SALVAGE_FRAMING.get(), cubeAll(ModBlocks.SALVAGE_FRAMING.get()));
        simpleBlockWithItem(ModBlocks.ADVANCED_SALVAGE.get(), cubeAll(ModBlocks.ADVANCED_SALVAGE.get()));

        // Generates the multi-texture cube model with individual face textures and an explicit particle texture
        ModelFile machineFrameworkModel = models().cube(
                "machine_framework",
                modLoc("block/machine_framework"),       // Down
                modLoc("block/machine_framework"),       // Up
                modLoc("block/machine_framework_front"), // North (Front)
                modLoc("block/machine_framework_back"),  // South (Back)
                modLoc("block/machine_framework_left"),  // West (Left)
                modLoc("block/machine_framework_right")  // East (Right)
        ).texture("particle", modLoc("block/machine_framework_front"));

        // Applies horizontal rotation blockstate variants and item model mapping for the machine framework
        horizontalBlock(ModBlocks.MACHINE_FRAMEWORK.get(), machineFrameworkModel);
        simpleBlockItem(ModBlocks.MACHINE_FRAMEWORK.get(), machineFrameworkModel);
    }
}
```

Run `./gradlew runData` again after saving, and your break/hit particles will display the correct texture instead of the pink-and-black void!

### Why the Machine Rotates

In Minecraft, item right-click methods execute before block interaction methods. If your `YoolItem` class contains a `useOn` method configured to rotate blocks, it intercepts the right-click event immediately. It performs the rotation and returns success, which stops the click from ever reaching `MachineFrameworkBlock#useItemOn` where your menu-opening logic lives.

To restore the correct functionality, you need to open `YoolItem.java` and update its interaction logic:

1. Locate the item interaction method inside `YoolItem.java` (typically `useOn`).
2. Remove any code that calls state rotation or modifies the block state facing.
3. Replace it with the logic that opens the `MachineConfigMenu` for the `MachineFrameworkBlockEntity`.

Keeping block rotation active ensures your rotation-agnostic IO configuration and blueprints continue to function correctly while the Yool serves its intended purpose as the configuration tool.

Putting rotation on the backlog keeps the current setup focused and stable. Cleaning up `YoolItem.java` ensures that regular right clicks pass through smoothly to open the configuration menu while keeping the block dismantling feature intact for shift clicks.

Here is the cleaned-up `YoolItem.java` file with clear, positive comments:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.custom;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModBlocks;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.entity.MachineFrameworkBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.context.UseOnContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

public class YoolItem extends Item {
    public YoolItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    /**
     * Handles tool interactions when right-clicking blocks in the world.
     */
    @Override
    public @NotNull InteractionResult useOn(@NotNull UseOnContext context) {
        Level level = context.getLevel();
        BlockPos pos = context.getClickedPos();

        // Breaks and drops the machine block when sneaking and right-clicking
        if (context.getPlayer() != null && context.getPlayer().isShiftKeyDown()) {
            if (!level.isClientSide) {
                BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
                if (blockEntity instanceof MachineFrameworkBlockEntity) {
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_FRAME_REMOVE_ITEM, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                    Block.popResource(level, pos, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.MACHINE_FRAMEWORK.get().asItem()));
                    level.removeBlock(pos, false);
                    return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
                }
            }
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        // Passes normal right clicks through so the block interaction opens the configuration menu
        return super.useOn(context);
    }
}
```

This version removes any leftover complexity and lets the block interaction handle opening the menu seamlessly.

### Gemini

Yes, that is the exact class. The reason the machine is still rotating or passing the click through is that the client side skips the server check and returns `PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION`. When the client passes, Minecraft can trigger default item or block behaviors.

To fix this completely, separate the Yool check and return `ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS` for both client and server sides so the game knows the interaction is fully handled.

Update the `useItemOn` method inside `MachineFrameworkBlock.java`:

```java
    @Override
    protected @NotNull ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(@NotNull ItemStack stack, @NotNull BlockState state, @NotNull Level level, @NotNull BlockPos pos, @NotNull Player player, @NotNull InteractionHand hand, @NotNull BlockHitResult hitResult) {
        if (stack.is(ModItems.BLUEPRINT.get())) {
            return ItemInteractionResult.SKIP_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
        }

        if (stack.is(ModItems.YOOL.get())) {
            if (!level.isClientSide && player instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer serverPlayer) {
                BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
                if (blockEntity instanceof MachineFrameworkBlockEntity frameworkEntity) {
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.LEVER_CLICK, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
                    serverPlayer.openMenu(frameworkEntity, buf -> buf.writeBlockPos(pos));
                }
            }
            return ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        if (!level.isClientSide && player instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer serverPlayer) {
            BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (blockEntity instanceof MachineFrameworkBlockEntity frameworkEntity) {
                serverPlayer.openMenu(new MenuProvider() {
                    @Override
                    public net.minecraft.network.chat.@NotNull Component getDisplayName() {
                        return frameworkEntity.getDisplayName();
                    }

                    @Override
                    public AbstractContainerMenu createMenu(int containerId, @NotNull Inventory playerInventory, @NotNull Player player) {
                        return frameworkEntity.createInfoMenu(containerId, playerInventory, player);
                    }
                }, buf -> buf.writeBlockPos(pos));
                return ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS;
            }
        }
        return ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS;
    }
```

This ensures right-clicking with the Yool intercepts the action immediately, plays the sound, opens the configuration menu, and returns success to stop any rotation behavior.

### Gemini

That event handler is the exact culprit. Because it listens globally for right-clicks with the Yool, it intercepts interactions on any block with a facing property, rotates it, and cancels the event before the block's own menu logic can run.

To fix this, add an exception for the machine framework inside `YoolInteractHandler.java` so it skips rotation for that specific block and allows the configuration menu to open normally.

Here is the updated `YoolInteractHandler.java`:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.event;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.custom.MachineFrameworkBlock;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HopperBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BlockStateProperties;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;

@SuppressWarnings("unused")
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID)
public class YoolInteractHandler {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        ItemStack stack = player.getItemInHand(event.getHand());

        if (stack.is(ModItems.YOOL.get())) {
            Level level = event.getLevel();
            BlockPos pos = event.getPos();
            BlockState state = level.getBlockState(pos);

            // Skips rotation for machine frameworks so the click passes through to open the configuration menu
            if (state.getBlock() instanceof MachineFrameworkBlock) {
                return;
            }

            if (state.is(Blocks.HOPPER)) {
                if (!level.isClientSide()) {
                    BlockState newState = state.cycle(HopperBlock.FACING);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                return;
            }

            if (state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.FACING)) {
                if (!level.isClientSide()) {
                    BlockState newState = state.cycle(BlockStateProperties.FACING);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                return;
            }

            if (state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING)) {
                if (!level.isClientSide()) {
                    BlockState newState = state.cycle(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Excluding the machine framework from this event allows right clicks with the Yool to open the configuration menu smoothly.

### Gemini

Switching from cycling property values to spatial rotation solves that issue. Using `Rotation.COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90` turns the block geometrically in a counterclockwise direction instead of jumping between states arbitrarily.

Here is the updated `YoolInteractHandler.java` using counterclockwise rotation:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.event;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block.custom.MachineFrameworkBlock;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BlockStateProperties;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;

@SuppressWarnings("unused")
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID)
public class YoolInteractHandler {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        ItemStack stack = player.getItemInHand(event.getHand());

        if (stack.is(ModItems.YOOL.get())) {
            Level level = event.getLevel();
            BlockPos pos = event.getPos();
            BlockState state = level.getBlockState(pos);

            // Skips machine frameworks to preserve menu interaction behavior
            if (state.getBlock() instanceof MachineFrameworkBlock) {
                return;
            }

            // Rotates directional blocks counterclockwise when clicking with the tool
            if (state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.FACING) || state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING)) {
                if (!level.isClientSide()) {
                    BlockState newState = state.rotate(Rotation.COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.0F);
                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Give this a try in your game and see how the rotation feels now.

That happens because hoppers can point downwards as well as horizontally. Geometric rotation cannot convert a downward-facing state into horizontal directions properly, which causes the rotation to fail on hoppers.

Restoring the explicit hopper check allows hoppers to cycle through all their valid directional states correctly while keeping geometric rotation for standard blocks.

```java
public class YoolInteractHandler {

    public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        ItemStack stack = player.getItemInHand(event.getHand());

        if (stack.is(ModItems.YOOL.get())) {
            Level level = event.getLevel();
            BlockPos pos = event.getPos();
            BlockState state = level.getBlockState(pos);

            // Skips machine frameworks to preserve menu interaction behavior
            if (state.getBlock() instanceof MachineFrameworkBlock) {
                return;
            }

            // Cycles hopper states to support downward and horizontal facings
            if (state.is(Blocks.HOPPER)) {

                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);

                }
                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
                return;

            // Rotates general directional blocks counterclockwise
            if (state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.FACING) || state.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING)) {
                if (!level.isClientSide()) {
                    BlockState newState = state.rotate(Rotation.COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90);
                    level.setBlock(pos, newState, 3);
                    level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.0F);

                event.setCanceled(true);
                event.setCancellationResult(InteractionResult.SUCCESS);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Gemini

**Confidence Level:** High

Minecraft marks base rotation methods on block states as deprecated because Mojang designs these methods to route through specific block definitions rather than direct state calls.

You can resolve this compiler warning using one of two standard approaches in mod development:

### Option 1: Route Rotation Through the Block Instance

Call the rotation method on the block itself instead of the block state:

```java
BlockState newState = state.getBlock().rotate(state, Rotation.COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90);
```

This delegates the rotation request to the block implementation and satisfies the compiler check.

### Option 2: Add a Suppression Annotation

Place a suppression annotation above your event handler method:

```java
@SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
```

Mod developers commonly use this annotation when interacting with vanilla Minecraft methods that carry deprecation tags for internal design reasons.

### You

the left and right side for the io module config window are flipped, i want them to be relative to the player, not the block

### Gemini

To make the left and right configuration buttons align with your viewpoint when looking at the machine, update `RelativeSide.java`. Swapping the clockwise and counterclockwise direction mappings for the left and right sides resolves the inversion.

Here is the updated `RelativeSide.java` file:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.block;

import net.minecraft.core.Direction;

public enum RelativeSide {
    FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN;

    public Direction toWorldDirection(Direction machineFacing) {
        return switch (this) {
            case UP -> Direction.UP;
            case DOWN -> Direction.DOWN;
            case FRONT -> machineFacing;
            case BACK -> machineFacing.getOpposite();
            case LEFT -> machineFacing.getClockWise();
            case RIGHT -> machineFacing.getCounterClockWise();
        };
    }

    public static RelativeSide fromWorldDirection(Direction worldDir, Direction machineFacing) {
        if (worldDir == Direction.UP) return UP;
        if (worldDir == Direction.DOWN) return DOWN;
        if (worldDir == machineFacing) return FRONT;
        if (worldDir == machineFacing.getOpposite()) return BACK;
        if (worldDir == machineFacing.getClockWise()) return LEFT;
        if (worldDir == machineFacing.getCounterClockWise()) return RIGHT;
        return FRONT;
    }
}
```

This maps the left GUI button to the clockwise world direction and the right GUI button to the counterclockwise world direction, matching your perspective correctly.

### Gemini

A configuration file provides useful options for adjusting balance and performance as your mod grows.

Even though everything works right now, a config file gives you control over several specific mechanics:

- **Automation Transfer Speeds:** You can expose the tick interval for item pushing and pulling, allowing players or modpack creators to make automation faster or slower.
- **Processing and Energy Multipliers:** If you add energy consumption, fuel costs, or recipe durations later, a config file lets users scale those values easily.
- **Module Restrictions:** You can define maximum stack limits or specific behaviors for modules without editing code.
- **Modpack Compatibility:** Other creators appreciate configuration files because they allow them to balance your machines alongside other mods.

Adding a basic config system using Forge Config Spec sets you up nicely whenever you want to make those values easily adjustable.

### Gemini

To improve a compass model and its dynamic tracking or texture implementation in your NeoForge mod, you will want to check a few specific file areas:

- **Custom Item Class:** Check if you have a dedicated item class for the compass where custom behaviors, target positioning logic, or NBT data reading are handled.
- **Client Setup / Property Registration:** Look for your client-side event subscriber or mod initialization class where `ItemProperties.register(...)` is called. This is necessary if your compass uses angle overrides, custom property predicates, or dynamic rotation frames like vanilla compasses.
- **Item Model JSON Files:** Check your resource directories under `assets/<modid>/models/item/` to inspect how the JSON file defines its model layers, predicates, or angle overrides.
- **Item Model Data Provider:** If you use data generation for your item models, check your item model provider class to see how item JSONs are generated programmatically.

### Gemini

Managing thirty-two separate PNG frames and thirty-two individual JSON files created via external Python scripts requires maintaining external assets outside your main source control. You can streamline this workflow by integrating model generation directly into your Java data generators and properly registering the client-side angle property.

### 1. Automating Model Generation in Java

You can generate your compass model overrides programmatically inside your `ModItemModelProvider` class using a simple loop. Java data generation handles file creation cleanly during your run data execution.

Here is how you can structure the override generation in your item model provider:

```java
public class ModItemModelProvider extends ItemModelProvider {
    public ModItemModelProvider(PackOutput output, ExistingFileHelper existingFileHelper) {
        super(output, PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, existingFileHelper);
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerModels() {
        ItemModelBuilder compassBuilder = withExistingParent("anomaly_compass", "item/generated")
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/anomaly_compass_00"));

        for (int i = 1; i < 32; i++) {
            String frameName = String.format("anomaly_compass_%02d", i);
            compassBuilder.override()
                    .predicate(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "angle"), (float) i / 32.0f)
                    .model(getExistingFile(modLoc("item/" + frameName)))
                    .end();
        }
    }
}
```

### 2. Registering the Compass Angle Property

For the compass needle to rotate toward your stored target coordinates (`TargetX` and `TargetZ`), your client setup class needs to register an item property override. This links your custom target calculations to the float predicate used by the item model.

Here is a standard client setup implementation:

```java
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
public class ModClientClientSetup {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> {
            ItemProperties.register(
                ModItems.ANOMALY_COMPASS.get(),
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "angle"),
                (stack, level, entity, seed) -> {
                    return AnomalyCompassItem.calculateAngle(stack, level, entity);
                }
            );
        });
    }
}
```

### 3. Workflow Benefits

Moving asset generation into your datagen classes and verifying your property registration keeps your project files organized inside your main source tree. This approach ensures all models and textures build consistently with your data generator pipeline without relying on external script executions.

### 3. Update `AnomalyCompassItem.java`

Add the `calculateAngle` method to compute the rotational angle toward your stored target coordinates:

```java
public static float calculateAngle(ItemStack stack, @org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable Level level, @org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity entity) {
    if (level == null && entity != null) {
        level = entity.level();
    }
    if (level == null) {
        return 0.0F;
    }

    CustomData customData = stack.get(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA);
    if (customData == null) {
        return 0.0F;
    }

    net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag = customData.copyTag();
    if (!tag.contains("HasTarget") || !tag.getBoolean("HasTarget")) {
        return 0.0F;
    }

    int targetX = tag.getInt("TargetX");
    int targetZ = tag.getInt("TargetZ");

    BlockPos entityPos = entity != null ? entity.blockPosition() : new BlockPos(0, 0, 0);
    double d3 = Math.atan2((double) targetZ + 0.5 - (entityPos.getZ() + 0.5), (double) targetX + 0.5 - (entityPos.getX() + 0.5));

    double angle = 0.0;
    if (entity != null) {
        float f = entity.getYRot();
        float f1 = net.minecraft.util.Mth.positiveModulo(f / 360.0F, 1.0F);
        angle = 0.5 - (f1 - 0.25 - (d3 / (Math.PI * 2)));
    } else {
        double d2 = Math.atan2(targetZ - entityPos.getZ(), targetX - entityPos.getX());
        angle = 0.5 - (d2 / (Math.PI * 2) - 0.25);
    }

    return net.minecraft.util.Mth.positiveModulo((float) angle, 1.0F);
}
```

### Gemini

NeoForge 1.21.1 deprecated and removed the `bus` parameter from the `@EventBusSubscriber` annotation. Mod event bus listeners register directly through the mod event bus inside your main mod constructor using a method reference or a lambda expression.

### Updated `ClientModSetup.java`

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.client;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.item.ItemProperties;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent;

public class ClientModSetup {

    public static void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> ItemProperties.register(
                ModItems.ANOMALY_COMPASS.get(),
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "angle"),
                (stack, level, entity, seed) -> com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.AnomalyCompassItem.calculateAngle(stack, level, entity)
        ));
    }
}
```

### Registration in Your Main Mod Class (`PraeteritumFuturumMod.java`)

Pass the client setup method reference directly to the mod event bus in your main mod constructor:

```java
public PraeteritumFuturumMod(IEventBus modEventBus, ModContainer modContainer) {
    // Other registrations...
    
    modEventBus.addListener(ClientModSetup::onClientSetup);
}
```

Alternatively, you can place the lambda expression directly inside the mod constructor:

```java
public PraeteritumFuturumMod(IEventBus modEventBus, ModContainer modContainer) {
    // Other registrations...

    modEventBus.addListener((FMLClientSetupEvent event) -> {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> ItemProperties.register(
                ModItems.ANOMALY_COMPASS.get(),
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "angle"),
                (stack, level, entity, seed) -> com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.item.AnomalyCompassItem.calculateAngle(stack, level, entity)
        ));
    });
}
```

This approach removes the deprecated annotation warnings and utilizes the standard NeoForge 1.21.1 event registration pattern.

### Gemini

The data generation task failed because your `ModItemModelProvider` loop tries to call `getExistingFile(modLoc("item/anomaly_compass_01"))`, but that file does not exist yet.

When you updated the model provider to loop through numbers 1 to 31, it looked for individual frame JSON files like `anomaly_compass_01.json` in your resources directory. Since those JSONs were deleted when you cleaned up the old files, the data generator threw an error.

### The Fix

You do not need to create 31 separate JSON files manually. Instead, modify your loop in `ModItemModelProvider.java` to generate the override models programmatically using built-in builders, or use `withExistingParent` for each frame.

Update your `ModItemModelProvider.java` file like this:

```java
package com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.datagen;

import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.ModItems;
import com.thextrunner.praeteritum_futurum.PraeteritumFuturumMod;
import net.minecraft.data.PackOutput;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.generators.ItemModelBuilder;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.generators.ItemModelProvider;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.data.ExistingFileHelper;

public class ModItemModelProvider extends ItemModelProvider {
    public ModItemModelProvider(PackOutput output, ExistingFileHelper existingFileHelper) {
        super(output, PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, existingFileHelper);
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerModels() {
        ItemModelBuilder compassBuilder = withExistingParent(ModItems.ANOMALY_COMPASS.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/anomaly_compass_00"));

        for (int i = 1; i < 32; i++) {
            String frameName = String.format("anomaly_compass_%02d", i);
            
            // Generate the individual frame model file programmatically
            withExistingParent(frameName, mcLoc("item/generated"))
                    .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/" + frameName));

            // Add the override predicate pointing to it
            compassBuilder.override()
                    .predicate(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PraeteritumFuturumMod.MODID, "angle"), (float) i / 32.0f)
                    .model(getExistingFile(modLoc("item/" + frameName)))
                    .end();
        }

        basicItem(ModItems.SALVAGE_SCRAP.get());
        basicItem(ModItems.REFINED_SCRAP.get());
        basicItem(ModItems.STRANGE_ARTIFACT.get());
        basicItem(ModItems.BLUEPRINT.get());

        withExistingParent(ModItems.YOOL.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/handheld"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/yool"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.SALVAGE_CUTTER.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/handheld"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/salvage_cutter"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.INVENTORY_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/inventory_module"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.IO_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/io_module"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.FILTER_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/filter_module"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.SMELTING_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/smelting_module"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.STONECUTTER_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/stonecutter_module"));

        withExistingParent(ModItems.COMPOSTER_MODULE.getId().getPath(),
                mcLoc("item/generated"))
                .texture("layer0", modLoc("item/composter_module"));
    }
}
```

By adding `withExistingParent(frameName, mcLoc("item/generated")).texture("layer0", modLoc("item/" + frameName));` inside the loop, the data generator automatically creates all 31 missing JSON files on the fly during execution before linking them as overrides. Run `runData` again after applying this change!
